title: Different cultures within MW?
content: My MW dreams are, most commonly, in my own culture and language. I imagine that's the norm. But I also have a pretty significant amount of dreams that focus on Chinese and Japanese culture, influence, and language. Like, I'm a frequent visitor to a Chinese wet market, and I've visited several Japanese MW landmarks. In those dreams, I can both understand and fluently speak those languages (not so, waking life. I've tried to learn, but foreign languages have always been a weakness for me). I've had those types of dreams, on and off, since childhood, but only in the last few years have I actively been consuming Chinese/Japanese media with any sort of consistency. As a direct result of the dreams suddenly increasing in frequency. Anybody else visit other cultures in their MWs?
